audits.comment: Applies to all City of Berkeley landlords; no unit, date or owner thresholds.

unverifiable_exemptions: units under owner move-back rental agreement
existing tenants subletting or adding/replacing roommates

evidence.quoted_span: Owner-occupied properties (between 1-3 units) in which an owner of record resides in one of the units as their primary residence

unverifiable_exemptions: owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant

audits.comment: Just cause covers fully and partially covered units, including new construction; no cutoff.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant

audits.comment: Relocation tied to just-cause coverage; local amounts govern over state relocation.

unverifiable_exemptions: single-family tenancies before 1996 are covered regardless of build date; condos mostly partially covered
certain Section 202/811 and HUD-insured subsidized units

evidence.quoted_span: New construction: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980**

audits.comment: Rent control excludes new construction with CO after June 1980.
Interest applies to fully or partially covered units; supplements state deposit rules.
Applies to all residential rental agreements.
